description: Rail Carriers, 2006 - Canadian National (CN) is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Natural Resources Canada | Ressources naturelles Canada. In 2006 there were 48 068 kilometres of railways, stretching from the Atlantic to the Pacific oceans. The two largest Class 1 carriers, Canadian National Railway Company (CN) which owns or leases 22 686 kilometres of railways and Canadian Pacific Rail Company (CPR) which owns or leases 12 812 kilometres. Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Natural Resources Canada | Ressources naturelles Canada. Its tags are carte, réseau ferroviaire, économie, economy, map. It offers 4 resource(s) in JP2, OTHER, ZIP. The portal shows 2022-03-14 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
